products.name: Firefly Creative Production
products.title: Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise
products.what: Adobe's enterprise offering for producing content variants in volume: teams build workflows on a visual canvas, publish them, and run them over batches of images, video and InDesign or Photoshop templates, in the Firefly app or through the Firefly Services APIs.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise overview

what_quote.quote: It is the umbrella product that brings together workflow authoring, headless creative services, production runtime, and the operational infrastructure needed to produce on-brand outputs at scale.

products.notes: This is Adobe's umbrella name: it includes access to the Firefly Services APIs (Firefly, Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator and Substance 3D APIs, and the Creative Production Workflow API), and customers of Firefly Services are entitled to it. Usage is charged in Operations from one pooled allowance: a workflow run is charged at the workflow rate for each output asset or second of video, a direct API call at the API rate, and the limit is set for the whole organization with no per-user cap in the Admin Console. Only the people who author workflows need full access; everyone else can run what has been published. A batch started through the Workflow API is visible only to the account that started it, and output links from the agent connector last about an hour, so FP05 and FP07 include where finished files are stored. These lines cover the Remove background, Crop and Color grade presets, Workflow Builder, the template and data merge nodes, publishing, the Workflow API, the Firefly Services APIs and the Run-Workflow MCP. Two more presets and the simple run screens authors can publish are left out: see left_out. The Lightroom API is not in scope: Adobe's page gives it an end-of-life notice. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: A Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise or Firefly Services entitlement, which Adobe sells on select enterprise plans
Users assigned to the product in the Admin Console by an administrator
Operations in the contract: usage is measured in Operations by workflow type and by the number of assets or seconds of video
For API use: an Adobe Developer Console project with OAuth Server-to-Server credentials, arranged with your client's Adobe representative
A desktop browser and English for the bulk actions

lines.scope: Set up the preset bulk actions for your client's production team: background removal and replacement, crop sizes and aspect ratios for each channel, and custom color presets, then run a pilot batch and write the house rules for file naming and review.

products.name: Firefly Custom Models
products.title: Adobe Firefly Custom Models
products.what: Private Firefly image models that your client trains on its own images, so generated images keep a brand's subject or style in Firefly and other supported Adobe apps.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Custom models overview

what_quote.quote: Custom models let you train and customize Firefly generative models using your own images, generating content that reflects a specific visual style or subject matter.

products.notes: These lines are for enterprise plans only: your client's Creative Cloud for enterprise plan must include custom models, and Adobe adds them through the account manager. A model is either a subject model (a product, character or object) or a style model (an illustration or photography look); it is trained on 10 to 30 images, and training takes from 30 minutes to several hours. Some use cases are for enterprise plans only: lifestyle photography, a photoshoot of a person, isometric and 3D graphics, brand expressions and backgrounds for product shots. Models are private until shared, and anyone with access to the project a model is stored in inherits access to it, so FM05 sets up projects before models multiply. A trained model cannot be edited: it is duplicated and trained again. Brand color control by HEX value and the Tune edit tool are left out: see left_out. Adobe reserves the right to limit users, training runs and concurrent generation requests. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.

Adobe storage for business on the organization
A product administrator for Firefly Custom Models, and each trainer given both the Trainer profile and a product that includes Firefly

products.name: Brand Intelligence
products.title: Adobe Brand Intelligence
products.what: A service with no app of its own, reached through APIs, that learns your client's brand rules from guidelines, approved assets and review decisions, then checks creative work against them (Validate), assembles on-brand variants from a brief (Instruct to Assemble) and tests creative on a synthetic audience (Simulate).

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Adobe Brand Intelligence overview

what_quote.quote: Adobe Brand Intelligence is a continuously learning brand intelligence platform that helps your teams create and validate on-brand content faster and with less effort.

products.notes: Brand Intelligence checks creative work against brand rules. It is not about AI search and has no tie to Brand Visibility. Adobe's own Forward-Deployed Engineers load and structure the brand data and configure the campaigns, channels, products and audiences a check can use: that work is a required part of the license, so partner lines here sit around it (gathering the sources, connecting the APIs to your client's tools, the review loop, training and upkeep) and never replace it. Each skill is its own add-on, licensed for each tenant, and each brand is licensed separately. The web app Adobe provides is a reference implementation that shows how Validate can be built into a client's own tools. The Validate REST API accepts uploaded assets only. Limits: 50 concurrent users and 5 terabytes of storage. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market client; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: All four required components licensed: at least one Brand, at least one Skills add-on, Operations, and Adobe Forward-Deployed Engineering resources
Operations licensed through Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise or the Shared Credits offering
Your client's brand profile configured by Adobe during onboarding, before any API call
An Admin Console administrator to give developers access to a product profile, for API credentials

lines.evidence: This guide is for teams integrating Adobe Brand Intelligence Simulate into their own chat assistant via its MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

source.title: Adobe Developer: Brand Intelligence Simulate, Using MCP

lines.name: Figma templates for assembled variants
lines.scope: Prepare your client's Figma templates for the Adobe Brand Intelligence plugin, agree the contexts and assembly options with Adobe's engineers, run first batches of two or three variants, and check the results with the design lead before larger runs.
lines.evidence: You can use Instruct to assemble in Figma via the Adobe Brand Intelligence plugin to quickly create multiple on-brand variants using predefined templates and brand guidelines.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Instruct to Assemble

lines.name: Reviewer training and rollout
lines.scope: Train your client's designers, reviewers and brand team to read findings, open the guideline behind each one, and approve, edit or reject suggestions, then roll the checks out team by team with a named owner for questions.
lines.evidence: Your approval, edits, or rejection of each suggestion feeds back into the Adobe Brand Intelligence for continuous learning.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Validate brand compliance

lines.name: Monthly brand rule review
lines.scope: Each month, review the findings reviewers rejected or edited, collect new guidelines and campaign rules from your client's brand team, pass changes to Adobe's engineers, and report how many assets passed first time.
lines.evidence: Instead of relying only on written guidelines, the system learns from your assets, past reviews, and team decisions, so your brand standards are applied consistently, every time.

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Adobe Brand Intelligence overview
